title: Abu Dhabi’s TAQA issues $750mln blue bond privately
summary: The five-year bond bears a coupon rate of 5.125%
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The blue bond was issued by TAQA via private placement, a route increasingly popular with issuers in the GCC looking to bypass public market volatility. Image courtesy: Getty Images

The five-year bond bears a coupon rate of 5.125%

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Abu Dhabi National Energy Company, known as TAQA has issued a $750 million blue bond to finance sustainable water and wastewater management projects.
